release_effect: All 60 Urdu A1 passages have now received semantic/linguistic pass 1. This manifest bounds known findings only; it is not an educator-ready certification, does not prove the four passages without pass-1 findings are defect-free, and does not authorize quality-field promotion.

repair_waves.name: corpus_wide_detection_before_edit
repair_waves.purpose: Run mechanical/systemic searches over the entire 60-passage canonical corpus before editing, so known defect classes are fully enumerated rather than fixed only where manually noticed.

repair_waves.name: learner_answer_correctness_and_grounding
repair_waves.selection_rule: All findings where official answer insertion is ungrammatical/wrong, answer order is reversed, Q/A linkage is mismatched, source/checkpoint facts conflict, or a source sentence contains a clear case/agreement error.

repair_waves.name: natural_urdu_and_a1_operationality
repair_waves.selection_rule: Forced target collocations, metalinguistic A1 questions, circular definitions, perspective/reference inconsistency, and unnatural beginner phrasing after Wave 1 is stable.

repair_waves.name: metadata_sense_and_pedagogical_classification
repair_waves.selection_rule: intended_sense scoping, question-type corrections, legacy quality-metadata reconciliation, and other metadata that must match repaired learner content.

repair_waves.name: minor_polish_and_regression_closeout
repair_waves.selection_rule: remaining minor wording/definition polish, followed by full deterministic and manual re-audit.

systemic_search_classes.goal: Mechanically insert every official cloze answer into every blank and flag count/order/agreement/case/unidiomatic failures.
Verify answer-list order exactly corresponds to blank order for all multi-blank questions.
Compare every Unit p06 checkpoint assertion and answer against p01-p05 source events; flag invented, contradicted, or weakened details.
Find lexical targets/reviews inserted in non-idiomatic contexts primarily to satisfy exposure requirements.
Find grammar_function, grammar_category, relation-label, formal morphology/gender, or similar A1 tasks that can be replaced by operational comprehension/use.
Check oblique case, ko/se/ke/ki/ka selection, adjective-noun gender, possessive agreement, and verb/adjective agreement in learner-facing content.
Find definitions that repeat the target, define with equally/harder formal vocabulary, or contain incoherent semantic explanations.
Find unmarked switches among first/second/third person, ambiguous pronoun antecedents, and possessive perspective shifts.
Find unrelated homonyms, unused polysemous senses, or missing senses actually exercised in canonical text.
Verify metadata type matches the actual cognitive task: literal, sequence, cause-effect, contrast, conditional, etc.
Audit checkpoint clozes as new learner-facing sentences rather than assuming source passage correctness propagates.
Identify pass/calibrated fields that conflict with deferred-audit notes or current confirmed findings; reconcile only through gate-specific revalidation.

edit_guardrails: Do not edit canonical learner-facing text until Wave 0 systemic enumeration is recorded.
Do not bulk-change quality fields. Each gate must be independently rerun on the repaired canonical blob.
Preserve lexical target IDs unless the intended sense or target itself is rejected; if rescheduled, explicitly repair introduction/review chronology.
Any learner-facing text change invalidates affected exact exposure counts and requires recounting.
Every checkpoint must be validated independently from its source passages.
Every cloze must be reconstructed mechanically with the official keyed answer(s) and then manually read as a full sentence.
All repairs must be blob-bound and bounded by passage ID/field before canonical edits are applied.
required_regression_after_each_repair_wa: review-target chronology and expected exposure numbers
fresh adversarial manual read of every changed passage
